purpose: Audit the Emerald PokéNav city-zoom cycling text sprite before removal from the authentic HGSS Map presentation.

legacy_asset.live_role: Three 32x8 OBJ slices are created and cycled as a legend while the PokéNav city preview is visible.

retail_hgss_findings.finding: Retail HGSS Map renders location text through SUB_1 windows over the Map detail layers; it does not create an Emerald-style cycling city-legend text sprite.
authentic_surfaces_already_live: HGSS Map member-62 window palette and retail text color tuple

geography_policy.keep_separate: The Hoenn city-map tilemaps and zoom_tiles.png remain classified as geography/content data in this phase.
geography_policy.forbidden: Do not replace them with HGSS SUB_3/member12+13 because those resources encode fixed retail Johto/Kanto city thumbnails.

next: Delete the now-dead Emerald city-zoom text sprite code, graphics binding, and asset; keep the Hoenn city-map geography/data intact.

validation.runtime_policy: All city-zoom text sprites are created invisible and every map-section path keeps them invisible, so the Emerald cycling legend cannot appear during this validation phase.
